name: Typed-Channel
description: Type-safe communication channel for sending and receiving messages between different contexts — workers, iframes, tabs, Figma plugins.

name: Nanotags
description: Nanotags is a lightweight, TypeScript-friendly library for building reactive Web Components on top of standard DOM APIs and Nano Stores, with automatic cleanup and hydration-first support in under 2.5 KB.

name: Astro-Pigment
description: Astro 6 documentation theme that turns markdown content into a polished docs site with dark mode, interactive playgrounds, SEO routes, and LLM-friendly endpoints in a single integration.

name: Datavolve
description: Datavolve is a tiny, type-safe TypeScript library for versioning persisted client data, safely evolving old localStorage, IndexedDB, or JSON state to the current shape through forward-only transforms with zero dependencies in 258 bytes.

name: Harmonizer
description: Harmonizer is an open-source color palette generator for UI design that creates accessible, perceptually consistent shades and contrast levels using OKLCH and APCA, available as both a web app and a Figma plugin.

name: Code-to-Markup
description: Convert code snippets into beautifully highlighted, self-contained HTML markup ready to paste into slides, docs, or emails.
